authors: Burke, C. J. and Rosenblatt, M.
title: A Markovian Function of a Markov Chain
annotation: Gives conditions under which a function of a Markov chain, a grouping of its states, is itself a Markov chain.

title: On the Identifiability Problem for Functions of Finite Markov Chains
annotation: Asks when two hidden chains produce the same observed process once their states are grouped, the identification question for lumped chains.

authors: Kemeny, J. G. and Snell, J. L.
title: Finite Markov Chains
annotation: Defines lumpability: grouping states gives a Markov chain for every starting distribution exactly when all states of a group have the same total rate into each other group.

title: On Stochastic Processes Derived From Markov Chains
annotation: Characterizes the processes that arise as functions of finite Markov chains.

authors: Colquhoun, D. and Hawkes, A. G.
title: On the stochastic properties of single ion channels
venue: Proceedings of the Royal Society of London B 211(1183):205-235
annotation: Derives the open and shut time distributions of a single ion channel whose observed state groups several hidden states. The durations are mixtures of exponentials, one for each hidden state in the group.

title: Matrix-Geometric Solutions in Stochastic Models: An Algorithmic Approach
annotation: Develops phase-type distributions, the absorption times of finite Markov chains, and the matrix methods built on them. Any distribution of durations on the positive axis can be approximated this way.

authors: Colquhoun, D. and Hawkes, A. G.
title: On the stochastic properties of bursts of single ion channel openings and of clusters of bursts
venue: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society of London B 300(1098):1-59
annotation: Extends the analysis to bursts of openings and clusters of bursts, whose structure shows how the hidden states connect.
